en.d: Traditional homemade soup made with chicken, noodles and vegetables, slowly cooked for a broth full of flavour. Warm, tasty and deeply comforting — just like home.

en.d: Fridays and Saturdays only. Pork skewers marinated in spices and herbs, slowly grilled until tender and juicy. Served with homemade satsibeli sauce, marinated onion and fresh tomatoes.

en.d: Fridays and Saturdays only. Pork skewers marinated in spices and herbs, slowly grilled until tender and juicy. Served with homemade satsibeli sauce, marinated onion and fresh tomatoes.

en.n: Beef stew with potatoes in cream

en.n: Pasta with chicken in cream sauce
